description: Election Commission - G. A. R. S. Sampath Was Selected as the Member of the Bingiriya Pradeshiya Sabha - K. B. Malkanthi Was Selected as the Member of the Palindanuwara Pradeshiya Sabha.
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in local government bodies (Pradeshiya Sabhas) due to member deaths, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of new members by political party secretaries and returning officers, which falls under electoral processes and related administrative matters. This fits Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) as it concerns electoral procedures for local authorities rather than central government personnel or structural changes.
